answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional network influence. An attacker faces the ridge of high capital expenditure, as creating fake identities necessitates burning assets rather than merely allocating timber or marble resources. This economic cost scales linearly with identity count, ensuring that malicious actors cannot achieve dominance through low-cost node replication without incurring prohibitive financial losses.
